from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,json,subprocess,re
from v3_revision import ROOT,dump
r=ROOT/'results/revision-20261023/round2';pdf=ROOT/'manuscript/revision-v3/paper.pdf';tex=pdf.with_name('main.tex')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
c=json.loads(pdf.with_name('paper-content.json').read_text());prior=json.loads((r/'post-correction-audit/prior-table-bodies.json').read_text());tables=[b for s in c['sections'] for b in s['blocks'] if b['type']=='table'];assert len(tables)==len(prior['tables'])==37
changed_rows=[i+1 for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(tables,prior['tables'])) if a['rows']!=b['rows']];assert not changed_rows,changed_rows
old=json.loads((r/'levy-ar-correction/prior-scientific-identities.json').read_text())['prior_result_hashes'];mismatches=[name for name,h in old.items() if sha(ROOT/name)!=h];assert not mismatches,mismatches
bound=json.loads((ROOT/'protocol/revision-20261023/D2-AR-correction-binding.json').read_text());print('D2 before-outcome binding fields:',list(bound))
text=tex.read_text();residue=[{'codepoint':f'U+{ord(ch):04X}','character':ch,'offset':i} for i,ch in enumerate(text) if '\u0370'<=ch<='\u03ff' or '\u2070'<=ch<='\u209f' or '\u2200'<=ch<='\u22ff'];assert not residue,residue[:20]
visual=json.loads((r/'visual-source-and-scope-g15-all-pages.json').read_text());assert visual['pdf_sha256']==sha(pdf) and len(visual['pages'])==40 and visual['blocking_defects']==0
pres=subprocess.run([__import__('sys').executable,'-B','round2_preservation_check.py'],cwd=ROOT,text=True,capture_output=True);assert pres.returncode==0,pres.stdout+pres.stderr
record=dict(actual_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),current_pdf_sha256=sha(pdf),current_tex_sha256=sha(tex),table_bodies_compared=37,changed_table_bodies=changed_rows,prior_scientific_files_compared=len(old),prior_scientific_mismatches=mismatches,raw_mathematical_codepoints_in_formal_tex=residue,source_compilation='DEFERRED_BY_USER: static math-source check only',preservation=json.loads(pres.stdout),visual_current_pages=3,visual_prior_byte_identical_pages=37,financial_refit=False,simulation_rerun=False)
dump(r/'post-correction-audit/source-scope-preservation-g15.json',record);print(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
